Maintainer approved queries 2026-08-09; 13-title / 119-section seed cards landed; labels filled for covered intents. Blank expect_section / expect_topic rows are deliberate content gaps (power-user / needs_clarification / no covering card) and are expected misses. Status: approved_for_rebuild_and_bakeoff (PR2 stage 6d). **2026-08-22 (D23):** the 15 paraphrase rows from `kb_eval_paraphrase_v0.json` were folded in as `V2-PARA-*`, all assigned `tune` before any tuning touched them (R1) — they paraphrase kb_eval_v0, which is card-derived throughout, and a paraphrase of a card-derived query is still card-derived, so none of them can serve as a ship gate. Scores measured from this date are a NEW SERIES and must not be compared with any report before it (R4); the last old-set report is docs/archive/research/kb-embed-bakeoff-2026-08-21-arms.md. 2026-08-28 (D37, proposed): 20 V2-BLIND-H* holdout rows added, written without reading any card body text -- see docs/audit/kb-blind-holdout-rows-2026-08-28.md. All assigned split=holdout (none tune), per the same R1 rule D23 used. Holdout numbers measured after this change are a NEW SERIES and are not comparable to any number measured before it (R4) -- the first such measurement happens after merge, not as part of this change.
